# Toy 101 L1 — Answers

Questions: [[Toy 101 L1 Questions]].

**1.** $\bar{k} = (0.3/0.1)^{2} = 9$.

> [!rubric]- Key steps
> - Set investment equal to depreciation: $sA\bar{k}^{\alpha} = \delta\bar{k}$
> - Solve for $\bar{k} = (sA/\delta)^{1/(1-\alpha)}$
> - Substitute the numbers to get $\bar{k} = 9$

**2.** No: saving raises the level of capital per worker, not its long-run growth.
